Under Care Of : Dr. Revathi Mudaliar, MD (Pulmonary Medicine) (Pulmonology)

FINAL DIAGNOSIS: Community acquired pneumonia, right lower lobe (ICD-10: J18.9)

CHIEF COMPLAINTS:
Cough with expectoration x 7 days, fever x 5 days, breathlessness (MMRC grade II) x 2 days.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
Cough productive of yellowish sputum. Fever moderate grade. K/c/o T2DM since 2023 on OHA. Non-smoker.

ON EXAMINATION:
Temp 100.8 F, PR 104/min, RR 26/min, SpO2 91% on RA, 96% on 2 L O2. Bronchial breath sounds and coarse crepts in right infra-scapular area.

INVESTIGATIONS:
CXR PA: right lower zone consolidation. TLC 16,800/cumm (N 86%). CRP 96 mg/L. Sputum AFB/CBNAAT: negative. RBS 248 mg/dL. CURB-65 score 1.

COURSE IN THE HOSPITAL:
Treated with Inj. Augmentin 1.2 g IV TDS, Tab. Azithromycin, nebulisation with Duolin and Budecort, O2 support, insulin for glycaemic control. Weaned off oxygen on day 4.

Occupation: shopkeeper

CONDITION AT DISCHARGE: Hemodynamically stable. Ambulatory.

DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS:
1. Tab. Augmentin 625 mg 1-0-1 x 5 days
2. Tab. Glycomet GP 1 1-0-1
3. Syp. Ascoril LS 10 ml TDS x 5 days

ADVICE: Incentive spirometry. Repeat CXR after 4 weeks.
Review in Pulmonology OPD on 06-Sep-2025 with Dr. Mudaliar. For appointments call 6429743056.
In case of emergency (chest pain, breathlessness, bleeding, high fever) call 108 or report to the Emergency Department.

Ref. Dr.:	Dr. Mathew, PHC Melur

Final Diagnosis: Acute inferior wall STEMI, single vessel disease (RCA), s/p primary PTCA + DES to RCA (ICD-10: I21.1)

Chief Complaints:
Retrosternal chest pain, compressive, radiating to left arm, with sweating x 3 hours.

History of Present Illness:
Sudden onset chest pain at rest. K/c/o systemic hypertension since 2018. Smoker (10 pack-years).

On Examination:
PR 58/min, BP 100/60 mmHg, SpO2 97%. S1S2 +, no murmur. Chest: clear.

Investigations:
ECG: ST elevation in II, III, aVF with reciprocal changes. Trop I: 18.4 ng/mL. 2D Echo: inferior wall hypokinesia, LVEF 45%. CAG: SVD - RCA 95% thrombotic occlusion.

Course in the Hospital:
Taken up for primary PTCA on 07/Jan/2022 at 09:10; DES deployed to RCA by Dr. Saranya Krishnan with TIMI III flow. Post-procedure uneventful. Mobilised and cardiac rehab counselling given.

Occupation: construction worker

Condition at Discharge: Stable, afebrile, tolerating oral diet.

Medications on Discharge:
1. Tab. Ecosprin 75 mg 0-1-0 after food (continue lifelong)
2. Tab. Clopilet 75 mg 0-1-0 x 1 year
3. Tab. Atorva 80 mg 0-0-1
4. Tab. Metoprolol 25 mg 1-0-1
5. Tab. Sorbitrate 5 mg SL SOS for chest pain

Advice: Do not stop antiplatelets without consulting a cardiologist. Stop smoking. Low salt, low fat diet.
Review in Cardiology OPD on 19/Jan/2022 with Dr Babu. For appointments call 0452-6388034.
In case of emergency (chest pain, breathlessness, bleeding, high fever) call 108 or report to the Emergency Department.
